newsitem.title: UK: Tchibo and four other UK coffee roasters up prices.
newsitem.headline: Tchibo and four other UK coffee roasters up prices.

text.p: The UK unit of German coffee roaster Tchibo Frisch-Roest-Kaffee GmbH and four other UK roasters said they were raising retail coffee prices by 16-20 percent between March 17 and April 1.
The Beverage Service Association, which represents 85 UK coffee supply firms, said in a statement that increases would amount to 75 pence per kilo.
Association chairman George Miller said Tchibo and three others -- Nairobi Coffee and Tea Ltd, Mastercoast Coffee Co Ltd and Gala Coffee and Tea Ltd -- would raise prices by around 17 and 20 percent.
Separately, Miller told Reuters his company First Choice Coffee Beverage Service Ltd would lift prices by 16 percent from April 1.

The retail price increase followed a similar action by other European and U.S. brands following continued sharp rally in world green coffee prices on fears of supply tightness. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
